reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (agent), blind look at every hole in both modes

bro-hof-stadium-h03.reason: Detaljerad 3D från tee: the large fairway bunker complex at 118–196 m, which both overhead views and the photo show left of the line, cannot be seen from the tee, so the hole reads as an empty pale fairway running into sun glare.
bro-hof-stadium-h03.resolution: From the tee's eye height the fairway falls 2.2 m to the bunker complex's near edge 118 m out, and on the laser terrain the sight line clears the ground there by 4 cm: the complex is seen edge-on, as the thin pale band below the horizon left of the aim, toward a low sun. The view is the same in the pictures before 27 November; the overhead views and Lätt 3D draw the bunker where the photo has it.

bro-hof-stadium-h07.reason: Detaljerad 3D från tee: a thin cyan line arcs across the grass right of the pond at mid-distance, and a dark half-disc is cut into the right edge of the frame at horizon height.
bro-hof-stadium-h07.resolution: The thin cyan line is Spellinje, the play-line guide that is on by default (main.js group tactical-guide): hiding that group removes it, and it is drawn over every hole by design. The dark half-disc at the right edge is the asphalt cart path bending past the tee, cut by the frame: a wider frame shows the path's curve.

bro-hof-stadium-h11.reason: Lätt 3D: the bunker distance label at the left edge by the green is cut off by the screen edge (reads "2–156 m").
bro-hof-stadium-h11.fault: Lätt 3D: the carry pill is cut off at the screen's left edge. Since PR 212 a bunker's pill stands beside its sand (apps/golf/src/map/map-overlay.mjs), and nothing keeps it inside the screen: clamp each pill to the viewport in map-overlay.mjs.

bro-hof-castle-h17.reason: Lätt 3D: a large patch of white speckles covers the open water right of the line from about 60 m to the tee and looks like static, not water.
bro-hof-castle-h17.fault: Lätt 3D: the white speckles are the map's sun glitter on the ripples (apps/golf/src/map/map-gl.mjs) in a view across the lake toward the sun; at the hole view's zoom they read as static, and two blind looks have doubted them. Tone the glitter down at hole-view zooms in map-gl.mjs.

bro-hof-castle-h18.reason: Detaljerad 3D från tee: a thin white-cyan line runs across the grass left of the aim line and along the near lake edge, drawn on top of the course.
bro-hof-castle-h18.resolution: The thin white-cyan line is Spellinje, the play-line guide that is on by default (main.js group tactical-guide): it follows the hole's route past the lake's edge, and hiding that group removes it; it is drawn over every hole by design.

open.canonical-control-pending: No independent horizontal or RH 2000 ground control has been measured at Bro Hof; the frame is the 1 m national terrain and the 0.16 m orthophoto, which agree with each other.
open.canonical-frame: The ground origin is fixed in software and has not been approved against independent control, as at every other ground.
open.release-review: The fourteen-gate release review (phone timings, offline and rollback rehearsal) is not run; by the owner's decision of 27 November 2026 the course is released on this blind visual review of every hole in both modes instead.
open.surface-intake-pending: All 36 holes were traced on the 2025 orthophoto, looked at hole by hole and blind by the ring reviewer; by the owner's decision of 27 November 2026 no person reviews the outlines before release.
